flags.why: “Tần ô” is mainly the Southern name for this vegetable and needs a regional label ([source](https://vnexpress.net/mien-nam-goi-la-tan-o-mien-bac-goi-la-gi-4777765-p2.html)).
“Tết nhất” refers to the Tet holiday period, not Tet plus other holidays ([source](https://znews.vn/sao-noi-tet-nhat-ma-khong-noi-tet-nhi-tet-ba-post1453346.html)).
The translation adds other holidays that “Tết nhất” does not denote ([source](https://znews.vn/sao-noi-tet-nhat-ma-khong-noi-tet-nhi-tet-ba-post1453346.html)).
flags.fix: With Tet so near, every household is busy shopping.
